results.title: Repeated interpersonal interaction leads to generalized long-term changes in int
results.reason: This study examines inter-brain synchrony changes during psychotherapy, directly relevant to clinical psychology practice. It investigates how repeated therapeutic interactions may lead to lasting neural changes that generalize to other relationships, with implications for understanding mechanisms of therapeutic change and interpersonal functioning in depression.
results.authors: Haran Sened; Keren Gorst Kaduri; Hadas Nathan Gamliel; Ayelet Avny; Tamar radai; sigal zilcha mano; Simone Shamay-Tsoory

results.reason: The paper examines anticipated stigma in healthcare settings and its impact on diagnostic delay for LGBTQ+ patients with endometriosis symptoms, which has direct clinical relevance for mental health professionals working with chronic illness populations and healthcare access issues.
results.authors: Ellen Frost; Madeleine Pownall; Daryl O'Connor
